# U.S. Environmental Protection Agency

> The EPA protects human health and the environment through research, regulation, emergency response, and enforcement of environmental laws.

The EPA website provides comprehensive resources on environmental protection, including regulatory guidance, scientific research, contamination cleanup, and public health guidance on indoor air quality, drinking water safety, and hazardous substances. The site serves federal agencies, businesses, and the general public with information on compliance, prevention strategies, and environmental topics ranging from air quality to waste management.

## Key Topics

- TSCA (Toxic Substances Control Act)
- PFAS (Per- and Polyfluoroalkyl Substances)
- Superfund
- RCRA (Resource Conservation and Recovery Act)
- TRI (Toxics Release Inventory)
- Air Quality
- Drinking Water Safety
- Greenhouse Gas Emissions
- Waste Management
- Indoor Air Quality
- Lead Contamination
- Radon
- Regulatory Compliance
- Emergency Response
- Environmental Protection

## Core Resources & Navigation

- [U.S. Environmental Protection Agency](https://www.epa.gov): EPA homepage defining the agency's mission to protect human health and environment
- [Environmental Topics](https://www.epa.gov/environmental-topics): Central directory of EPA resources covering environmental issues and research
- [A - Z Topic Index](https://www.epa.gov/topics-epa-web): Alphabetical index of EPA environmental topics, standards, and resources

## Laws, Regulations & Compliance

- [Laws & Regulations](https://www.epa.gov/laws-regulations): Overview of EPA laws, regulations, compliance, and enforcement information
- [Regulatory Information By Business Sector](https://www.epa.gov/regulatory-information-sector): Sector-specific regulatory and compliance information organized by NAICS code
- [Regulatory and Guidance Information By Topic](https://www.epa.gov/regulatory-information-topic): Topic-based EPA regulations, guidance, and compliance information directory

## Research & Emergency Response

- [Research](https://www.epa.gov/research): EPA's Office of Research and Development scientific products, tools, and events
- [Emergency Response](https://www.epa.gov/emergency-response): EPA emergency response resources for oil spills, chemical releases, and disasters

## Public Health & Indoor Air Quality

- [Lead](https://www.epa.gov/lead): Comprehensive guide on lead health effects, testing, certification, and RRP rule
- [Radon](https://www.epa.gov/radon): Radon health risks, testing, mitigation strategies, and National Radon Action Plan
- [Mold](https://www.epa.gov/mold): Indoor mold control and moisture management guidance for homes and buildings
- [Bed Bugs: Get Them Out and Keep Them Out](https://www.epa.gov/bedbugs): Step-by-step IPM guides for bed bug prevention, identification, and treatment
